source.note: The detached directory contains source files but no .git directory, package manifest, version file, source URL, or license metadata. This manifest pins observed content without claiming an upstream release or commit.

tree.digestScope: Each regular file except .DS_Store, represented by its SHA-256 plus sorted ./relative path; excludes .DS_Store, mtimes, permissions, extended attributes, directory entries, and other filesystem metadata.

generation.treeDigestCommand: LC_ALL=C find . -type f ! -name .DS_Store -print0 | LC_ALL=C sort -z | xargs -0 shasum -a 256 | shasum -a 256
generation.byteCountCommand: find . -type f ! -name .DS_Store -exec stat -f '%z' {} + | awk '{s+=$1} END{print s+0}'
generation.verificationRule: A matching tree digest proves byte-for-byte identity for the regular files and relative paths covered by digestScope. It does not identify an upstream commit or release.
